jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you'll do

As a Fraud Strategy Associate, you’ll own the end-to-end integrity of Brex’s fraud and risk ecosystem across credit, deposit, and card payment rails. You'll find patterns, trace root causes, and build the detection logic, automations, and reporting that keep fraud in check without adding friction for customers. You’ll design your own solutions, see fraud across every product vertical, and partner with Risk, Data Science, Engineering, and Product to build prevention into the product itself. 

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Strategic Analysis & Detection

  • Data Mining: Use SQL and Python to mine large-scale data, and apply LLM-based tools to detect and automate the identification of fraudulent patterns across credit, deposit, and card payment rails.
  • Vendor and Rule Optimization: Design and refine automated detection logic to proactively mitigate risk while maintaining a frictionless experience for legitimate customers.
  • Emerging Threat Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends and regulatory shifts to rapidly deploy new defensive strategies against novel fraud vectors.

Operational Excellence & Process Ownership

  • Workflow Architecture: optimize the internal processes for fraud investigations, ensuring operational discipline, case visibility, and high-fidelity documentation.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the strategic bridge between Risk Leadership, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to integrate fraud-prevention infrastructure into the core product lifecycle.
  • Tooling & Infrastructure: Define and manage the technical requirements for internal AI-driven tools and third-party risk-reduction platforms.

Metrics, Reporting & Performance

  • KPI Management: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as false positive rates, fraud capture rates, and operational turnaround times.
  • Executive Dashboards: Build and maintain scalable reporting suites to provide real-time visibility into fraud exposure and program effectiveness for senior stakeholders.
  • Impact Assessment: Conduct deep-dive post-mortems on fraud incidents to quantify financial impact and recommend structural process improvements.

We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. ABOUT THE ROLE As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations. This role is based in Seoul, South Korea. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects. - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities. - Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes. - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment. - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production. - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans. - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders. - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams. - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged. - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization. - Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities. - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices. jobs.title: Product Engagement Manager, User Operations
jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Support team is central to ensuring that our customers' experience with our products is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Product Engagement Manager on the User Operations team, you will lead a team of Product Engagement Specialists responsible for ensuring smooth, successful product launches across internal and external teams. You’ll be the glue connecting product teams and support operations, equipping teams with the tools and knowledge needed to support new product rollouts. You’ll build scalable feedback loops that capture the voice of the user and translate insights into actionable product improvements, and ensure that frontline teams have the knowledge and skills to deliver accurate, delightful customer interactions at scale. We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of product management, team enablement, and customer advocacy, and who enjoys working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment. This person will manage the day-to-day work while also helping architect the systems needed to scale it. The successful candidate will be a leader-coach who can lead a small team while continuing to perform individual contributor work. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Lead a team coordinating product launches across internal and external teams, ensuring seamless execution and support readiness. - Set the team’s strategy and priorities, translate them into clear goals and quality standards, and allocate capacity to deliver against them. - Build a high-performing team through ongoing coaching, feedback, development, and performance management. - Build out a Voice of the User program with scalable feedback loops between support, Product, and Engineering pre and post launch, so customer insights inform product development and strategy. - Advocate for users by representing their needs and pain points in product and engineering discussions. - Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to align on launch goals and timelines. - Monitor post-launch performance and gather support data to assess product impact and inform improvements. - Document and standardize launch procedures to make them repeatable and scalable. - Identify launch risks and propose solutions that minimize disruption to customers. - Report on feedback-loop performance, including key insights, trends, and recommendations for the product roadmap. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have experience leading product enablement or launch-readiness functions at scale, particularly in a customer support environment. - Have shipped tooling or automations that reduced manual work and scaled beyond a single team (workflows, dashboards, scripted automation, lightweight pipelines)." - Have experience in product management with automation and tool development, using metrics and feedback to improve decisions and processes. - Build strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams. - Are passionate about customer advocacy and can translate customer feedback into strategic product insights. - Are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines. - Communicate technical concepts and customer pain points clearly to diverse audiences. - Take ownership of initiatives from ideation through implementation and post-launch analysis. - Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. jobs.description: About the Team Critical Harm Operations sits within User Safety & Risk Operations and builds enforcement systems for the most severe user-safety risks—including Frontier Risk and Material Harm—that are accurate, fast, defensible, and scalable. The Cyber vertical turns policy into reviewer standards, calibrated judgment, quality systems, escalation paths, and safe automation. About the Role We’re looking for a senior cybersecurity and cyber intelligence practitioner who is also an operations leader, strategist, and people manager. You’ll bring sound cyber judgment, strong analytical and automation instincts, and the ability to stay close to the work while setting direction, managing and developing people, aligning partners, building programs from 0→1, and translating ambiguity into durable operating systems. This role combines senior individual-contributor depth with direct people-management accountability. You’ll personally shape complex cyber judgments, operating models, SOPs, quality systems, and automation strategies while building, coaching, and holding accountable a high-performing team. You’ll also lead through influence across FTEs, BPO partners, and cross-functional teams. Baseline operational health—including quality, queue coverage, productivity, and SLA adherence—is table stakes; success is additionally measured by durable improvements to decision quality, stakeholder alignment, reviewer capability, and the systems that run the operation. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Set the strategic direction for Cyber Operations and translate high-level organizational priorities into a clear operating model, roadmaps, SOPs, escalation paths, quality goals, and safe-access strategies. - Serve as the senior cybersecurity and cyber intelligence expert for complex and high-risk decisions across ChatGPT, API, Codex, agents, and emerging product surfaces. - Build trust, create clarity, navigate disagreement, and move people through ambiguity across FTEs, BPO partners, and cross-functional teams. - Turn policy ambiguity, quality misses, appeals, and reviewer disagreement into clear decision rules, calibration examples, training, and tooling requirements. - Build and scale reviewer capability through onboarding, certification, coaching, feedback, recurring calibration, and close partnership with vendor leadership. - Own operational health across Cyber Operations, including queue coverage, reviewer productivity, quality metrics, SLA adherence, escalation hygiene, and proactive identification of performance gaps before downstream teams need to flag them. - Use analysis and automation to diagnose root causes, surface risk, prioritize high-leverage fixes, and reduce manual effort. - Build durable quality and evaluation systems that improve decision quality through calibration, adjudication, monitoring, and feedback loops. - Build new operational capabilities from 0→1, then scale them: define the problem, align partners, test the model, establish metrics, and turn what works into repeatable operations. - Present crisp recommendations, tradeoffs, and operational strategy to executives and internal and external partners; represent Cyber Operations in high-stakes discussions and launch decisions. jobs.title: Asset Compliance Program Lead, Hardware
jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Central Procurement – Hardware Operations team is building scalable, AI-enabled operating foundations for a rapidly growing hardware footprint. We help the business move quickly while maintaining the data quality and controls needed to manage financial and operational risk responsibly. As OpenAI scales across R&D, new-product introduction, manufacturing, and third-party custody models, we are building the foundations to absorb complexity without adding unnecessary friction. That means establishing practical standards, strengthening discipline where it matters, using AI thoughtfully, and continuously improving how teams manage hardware operations. About the Role We are hiring an Asset Compliance Program Lead to establish the cross-business framework that gives OpenAI reliable lifecycle visibility over hardware-related financial assets and capital equipment. You will define the controls, systems roadmap, and evidence practices needed to manage those assets within OpenAI’s financial-control scope. This is a senior individual-contributor role in Central Procurement – Hardware Operations within Finance. Distinct from sourcing and transaction execution, you will partner with hardware business units, Accounting, Financial Risk Management, Procurement, contract manufacturers, and other third-party custodians to deploy practical operating mechanisms. These mechanisms will connect how assets are purchased, built, received, moved, held, verified, and retired with the ownership, data, reporting, and evidence needed for financial governance. The role covers those assets regardless of location or custody, including manufacturing equipment and tooling, supplier- and contract-manufacturer-held assets, leased assets, and other third-party-held equipment. You will stay close to the operational details—how assets move, where records diverge, which controls are not working, and where evidence is incomplete—and use that view to strengthen processes, accountability, and systems without compromising speed or flexibility. In this role, you will: - Design and scale the end-to-end asset-compliance operating model across acquisition and capitalization, custody and location tracking, transfers, lifecycle events, inventory and verification, impairment or retirement, and audit-evidence retention. - Define the authoritative asset record and systems roadmap, connecting requests, contracts, purchase orders, invoices, receiving, inventory data, physical custody, transfers, and financial records. - Establish clear ownership and control points across OpenAI teams, suppliers, contract manufacturers, logistics providers, and other third-party custodians. - Build lifecycle reconciliations and a scalable verification model across multiple internal and third-party sites, using risk-based inventories, sample testing, attestations, and corrective-action tracking to identify missing records, ownership or location gaps, unrecorded transfers, unresolved exceptions, and incomplete audit evidence. - Establish an initial baseline of asset exposure and control gaps, then prioritize remediation based on financial, operational, custody, and reporting risk. - Identify recurring issues and use process, system, workflow, automation, and AI-enabled improvements to prevent repeat problems and improve the stakeholder experience. - Shape policy, standards, and governance improvements by bringing operational evidence, implementation insight, and risk findings to the appropriate decision-makers. - Define executive reporting on asset completeness, control performance, audit readiness, remediation progress, and emerging risks. We’re looking for someone who can both operate and improve the system. This person will be hands-on in asset compliance while building the next version of how the work gets done: clearer standards, reliable data, stronger operating discipline, smarter workflows, and more AI-enabled ways of working. You might thrive in the role if you: - Have 8+ years of experience in hardware operations, supply chain, manufacturing, asset management, procurement operations, audit, risk and controls, or a similarly control-intensive environment; including experience owning or improving end-to-end asset, custody, inventory, or third-party control processes. - Are experienced in operating in complex hardware environments, such as contract manufacturing, supplier- or third-party-held assets, manufacturing equipment or tooling, global custody, logistics, or physical inventory and verification. - Demonstrate systems fluency, including ERP platforms such as SAP or Oracle and the data flows among procurement, purchase orders, invoices, receiving, inventory, asset records, and the general ledger; experience defining or improving asset-management, workflow, reporting, or control systems. - Have experience establishing audit readiness through risk-based testing, reconciliations, evidence reviews, and remediation; able to build practical operating mod

We enable business agility, operational excellence, and financial controls across procure-to-pay, quote-to-cash, supply chain, financial planning, and asset management. We partner closely with Procurement, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Security, Data, and Engineering to simplify complex processes, modernize financial platforms, and build AI-first solutions that scale with OpenAI. jobs.description:
POS-34039

Core partner development manager, UKI 


Why this role matters now

HubSpot is moving from selling hubs to selling seats with credits. Customers get the whole platform from day one, and what they pay increasingly depends on how much they use it. That changes what a partner is for. Under the old model, value meant a configured product, and a partner’s work often ended at go-live. Now value means an outcome that is activated and kept working, because credits only get used when someone keeps workflows, agents and data running.

For partners, this is a chance to earn more. Continuous activation and optimisation, sold as a sequence of outcomes, is worth far more than a one-off implementation. Each follow-on outcome is also a chance to source more consumption for HubSpot.

You are how this reaches partners. Many of them feel unsure who they are in the new model. You will help them see where they fit, shape repeatable outcome offers and retainers, and get ready to step in at any point in a customer’s journey, including when our customer success teams spot an unmet outcome. We want partners to get excited about this and build with us. You’ll also carry what you hear on the ground back to the teams shaping our programme, tooling and enablement.


What you’ll do

  • Manage a book of partners, and drive partner-sourced revenue and retention across it.
  • Build mutual action plans with each partner, tying their priorities and growth goals to ours.
  • Coach partners to build their own sourcing plans, from sales hires and BDRs to marketing, and to sharpen how they sell HubSpot.
  • Help partners move from implementation to activation and optimisation, including packaging repeatable outcome offers and retainers.
  • Work deals alongside HubSpot sales reps, bring partners in where they add most value, and solve escalations with Sales and Customer Success.
  • Run a steady operating rhythm: MAP check-ins, KPI reviews, accurate forecasting, early risk flags and ownership of business reviews.
  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from partner planning and outreach to reporting, and help partners do the same.
  • Be the voice of the partner inside HubSpot, and report feedback that improves the partner and customer experience.
  • Adapt quickly as our programme, products and playbooks change.


What we’re looking for

  • Experience in sales, partner channel development, business development or alliance management in technology, ideally SaaS.
  • Strong fluency in CRM and software platforms, and a clear understanding of how agencies and consultancies make money, from services and retainers to pricing and margin.
  • A coaching mindset. You enjoy teaching others and can lift the sales and delivery capability of a partner team.
  • Credibility with senior decision-makers at partners, and with sales reps who need to trust you in a live deal.
  • Comfort with data and forecasting, and the discipline to follow through on commitments.
  • Curiosity about AI and a habit of testing new ways of working.
  • Ease with change. You can take an ambiguous problem, make sense of it and propose a path forward.
  • A real interest in customers and in HubSpot’s mission of helping millions of organisations grow better.

If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

jobs.title: Director UX Research
jobs.description:
Location Details: United States, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.  

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.

Join our team

GoDaddy is in the middle of a significant product transformation. Roughly two-thirds of our product development work now involves artificial intelligence, and the questions our product teams need answered have changed fundamentally. We're no longer just evaluating interfaces. But the dynamic human-AI systems: whether they're useful, trustworthy, recoverable, and understood by the customers who depend on them.

We are seeking a Director UX Research for the Product Experience group to join our team! Partnering directly with collaborators across business functions, your mandate is twofold. Set and uphold the research standard for user experience professionals conducting generative and iterative research. Support partner teams doing small-batch testing. Additionally, personally lead strategic and AI evaluation work that demands dedicated research depth.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a research queue. It's for a leader who sees research as both a customer intelligence capability and a product quality system and who knows how to operate both at the speed modern product development demands. GoDaddy's UX designers are capable practitioners who handle a significant volume of discovery and evaluative research. The research team's value is highest where that work can't go: complex AI experience evaluation, cross-product synthesis, foundational understanding of customer behavior, and the strategic questions that require dedicated depth!

What you'll get to do...

Research Strategy and Prioritization
  • Define a research agenda that sits ahead of product roadmaps, not behind them — identifying the questions that need to be answered before key product and architectural decisions are made
  • Partner with Product, Build, and senior Engineering management to align research priorities against product risk, customer impact, and AI complexity

Risk & Monitoring Analyst III

As a Risk & Monitoring Analyst III, you'll join the Risk & Controls team, which is responsible for conducting QA audits on Transaction Monitoring alerts across Coinbase's CX and Compliance production teams. You'll audit TMS and KYC-related activity to identify opportunities that improve programmatic execution, from procedural updates and analyst training to metrics creation and check-and-challenge reviews. Your insights will flow directly into feedback loops that strengthen how Coinbase detects and responds to financial crime.

What you'll do:

  • Execute weekly QA audit allocations on complex TMS and KYC cases, performing detailed error analysis and documenting findings with clear, actionable recommendations for production teams.
  • Conduct root cause analysis on audit findings, identifying procedural gaps, recurring themes, and knowledge gaps across CX and Financial Crime Compliance teams to drive targeted upskilling and process improvements.
  • Build and deliver QA metrics, insights, and data-driven recommendations to Client Service Management, using trend analysis and impact assessment to prioritize the highest-value improvements.
  • Partner with Data Analytics, Operations, Financial Crime Compliance, and L&D teams to launch or enhance processes, workflows, and training programs based on QA findings.
  • Design and refine QA rubrics, frameworks, and scoring methodologies to ensure consistent, scalable audit standards across compliance operations.
  • Lead improvement projects end-to-end, from impact analysis and stakeholder alignment through execution and measurement, ensuring outcomes are delivered on time and to quality standards.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience executing QA, audit, or compliance testing programs across financial services, with working knowledge of BSA/AML laws, regulations, and rules.
  • Experience working across multiple AML systems and programs (e.g., KYC, AML, EDD, TMS, sanctions), with the ability to audit complex cases and identify systemic control gaps.
  • Demonstrated track record developing compliance metrics and reporting, with intermediate-to-advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides.
  • Proven ability to conduct root cause analysis, translate findings into procedural improvements, and collaborate cross-functionally with global partners across CX, compliance, analytics, and L&D.
  • Experience managing projects from scoping through delivery, with a track record of meeting quality standards and deadlines in a fast-paced compliance environment.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We are the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what is possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the first contact. We shape the culture at Brex by hiring the designers who define how our products look, feel and function.

What you'll do

This role is responsible for partnering with hiring managers and design leadership to define team needs and role requirements, ensuring alignment on hiring goals across Product Design, Brand Design, and Design Leadership.

You’ll source, engage, and assess world-class design talent through diverse channels, while managing the full recruitment lifecycle from outreach to onboarding. You will develop strategies to attract and retain diverse design talent, proactively building pipelines for both immediate and long-term hiring needs.

You’ll track and analyze key hiring metrics to improve recruiting effectiveness, collaborate cross-functionally to ensure fair and consistent evaluation practices, and champion Brex’s employer brand within the design community. Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home.   • Lead sourcing and outreach for design roles, using recruiting platforms, creative communities, portfolio sites and social networks.

  • Partner with design leaders to calibrate on craft standards, hiring bar and team composition.

  • Help shape and promote Brex's design employer brand.

Requirements

  • Proven experience recruiting for design roles (Product Design and Brand Design) in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with AI tools, recruiting platforms and creative talent networks.
  • Ability to assess design portfolios and understand craft, systems thinking and user-centered methods.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven mindset: interprets recruiting metrics and drives process improvements.
  • Manages multiple searches and priorities at once.

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with compensation strategy and market analysis for design roles.
  • Employer branding or talent marketing experience focused on the design community.

jobs.title: Partner Development Team Manager, Japan
jobs.description:
POS-P335

 

Partner Development Team Manager, Japan

About HubSpot

HubSpot is a leading customer relationship management (CRM) platform designed to help companies scale and grow. Our mission is to empower tens of thousands of customers worldwide by providing them with the marketing, sales, and customer success software they need to not just grow, but to grow better.

Our culture is built on a shared passion for our mission and is driven by amazing, growth-minded people. At HubSpot, we live by our HEART values: Humble, Empathetic, Adaptable, Remarkable, and Transparent. We are committed to creating an environment where our team members feel empowered to do their best work, wherever they are.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Partner Development Team Manager to lead our dynamic team in Japan. This is a crucial leadership role within an expanding region, offering a unique opportunity to shape the foundations of our Partner Development organization.

As the PDM Manager, you will be instrumental in developing and evolving our partner ecosystem, with a strategic focus on the Upmarket space and driving partner-sourced business. You will be responsible for hiring, coaching, and leading a team of Partner Development Managers (PDMs) in a fast-paced environment. We are looking for a passionate and experienced leader who can build a high-performing team, foster a culture of continuous learning, and inspire both your team and our partners towards a collective vision.

This role is based in our Tokyo office area, with the expectation of coming into the office on a regular basis.

What You'll Do

As the Partner Development Team Manager, you will:

  • Lead and Inspire: Guide and manage the Partner Development team to exceed quarterly MBOs and monthly milestones, focusing on driving partner-sourced revenue, increasing revenue retention, and improving the selling rate.
  • Coach and Develop: Build trust with your team and provide continuous developmental feedback. You will coach team members to enhance their holistic partner development skills.
  • Build and Recruit: Take responsibility for maintaining headcount by actively recruiting, selecting, and training new Partner Development Managers to attract and retain top talent.
  • Drive Strategic Growth: Utilize your business acumen to guide your team in strategic partner growth conversations and planning, with a focus on partner-led demand generation.
  • Engage with Partners: As a key channel leader for the region, you will regularly engage with partners to build executive relationships and address any escalations.
  • Collaborate Across the Business: Work proactively with direct sales managers, directors, and executives to foster business growth and support cross-functional projects.
  • Leverage Data: Employ an analytical mindset to identify trends, pinpoint gaps, and use data to inform strategy and drive team performance.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a candidate with a proven track record in partner leadership and team management. Key qualifications include:

Experience Requirements 

To be considered for this role, you'll need a significant background in leadership and the tech industry. The key experience requirements are:

  • Partner Leadership: You must have over five years of experience in a partner leadership position where you have demonstrably built and expanded a partner ecosystem (5+ years)
  • Management: Previous management experience is a mandatory requirement for this position (2+ years)
  • Tech Background: Experience working in the technology sector is highly desirable.
  • Sales Environment: You should have experience either managing or being managed within a structured sales environment.

Skills Requirements 

The role demands a combination of strong interpersonal and analytical abilities to effectively lead the team and drive results. Essential skills include:

  • Language: Professional fluency in English is required.
  • Coaching: You need superior coaching skills, with the proven ability to observe and evaluate your team's performance and use various techniques to improve their results.
  • Analytical Mindset: You must possess strong analytical skills to identify trends and gaps in performance. This includes leveraging and communicating data to drive strategic decisions and improve key performance indicators.
  • Collaboration: The ability to work and collaborate effectively with other departments is essential for driving business results. This includes proactively working with direct sales managers, directors, and executives.

jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

As a Business Systems Analyst, you'll own the systems that power our recruiting experience, including our recruiting tools and Sana. You'll work with Recruiting, People Operations, and Engineering to understand how hiring work gets done today, find where it can be faster and simpler, and turn that into configured systems and AI agents. You'll partner with engineers to design, build, and test agents that remove manual steps from recruiting processes. You'll independently lead projects from discovery through launch, set your own priorities within the team's roadmap, and serve as a trusted advisor to Recruiting leaders on systems and automation.

About the Team

You'll join the People Technology team within People Operations, Services & Technology, which builds and runs the systems and automation behind Gusto's People programs. The team works horizontally across People functions, partnering with Recruiting, HR operations, and Engineering to turn process improvements into tools Gusties and hiring teams use every day.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day:

  • Own the administration, configuration, and roadmap for recruiting tools and Sana, including integrations, access, and change management
  • Lead requirements gathering with Recruiting and write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Partner with engineers to design, build, test, and launch AI agents and automations that streamline recruiting processes, and help decide when to configure, build, or buy
  • Map current-state workflows, identify friction, and drive improvements end to end, measuring their impact
  • Manage multiple projects at once, communicate status and trade-offs to senior stakeholders, and keep documentation and training current
  • Share best practices and support less experienced teammates as the team's recruiting systems and automation work grows

Here's what we're looking for:

  • 4–6 years in HRIS, recruiting systems, business systems analysis, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience owning and configuring an ATS or HR system (Greenhouse, Workday, or similar), including integrations
  • Track record of leading projects from requirements through launch with measurable results
  • Strong requirements gathering, process mapping, and documentation skills
  • Experience partnering with engineers on design, testing, and launch, and comfort with light scripting or automation tools
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, building AI tools and agents to improve a process
  • Clear communication, including presenting to senior stakeholders, and the ability to prioritize competing requests

Our cash compensation range for this role is $107,000/yr to $130,000/yr in Denver, and $130,000/yr to $160,000/yr in San Francisco, New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

We're looking for a Motion & Brand Designer who is a hands-on maker: someone who loves the craft of visual design and motion, takes real ownership of creative output, and wants to help define how Gusto looks, feels, and moves across our brand. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on brand craft, motion design systems, and the variety of deeply considered visual work that makes a B2B brand feel genuinely human.

In this role, you'll own creative work from early concept through final delivery. You'll make judgment calls about typography, composition, color, and motion, and increasingly, that judgment extends to the AI-assisted work happening around you. You'll know when a generated output is right for the brand and when it isn't, and you'll be able to say why. You'll help introduce motion as a foundational part of how we build brand as someone who thinks in motion and ensures it's part of the creative process from the start.

About the Team

Brand design is how Gusto earns trust, builds recognition and insight, and makes people feel something before they ever read a word. Our Brand is about how we show up in every moment and this team owns some of its most important attributes from how we use language to typography, from color and composition to illustration, motion. These aren't finishing touches. They're critical to how we show who we are and why we're different.

Gusto is expanding our in-house creative studio inside a fast-moving, late-stage startup. We launch products, educate customers, run brand campaigns, and show up at events, and we do all of it with a consistent visual language and voice that needs to work across digital channels, motion formats, physical environments and everything in between. In the same week, you might be designing the visual system for a product launch and art directing an illustration library that will scale across the entire brand.

AI is part of how this team works. We use it to advance faster, explore more territory, and reduce the distance between a concept and something real. What we're looking for isn't just someone who uses these tools but someone who can direct them. Someone who sets the creative standard for what AI output is and isn't acceptable for the Gusto brand, and who helps us build the guardrails and workflows that let the whole team produce at a higher level.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day

  • Design and execute visual and motion work across product launches, product education, brand campaigns, events, and digital channels

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intel

As a Privacy Analyst on the Privacy Operations team within Security, you'll play a central role in how Coinbase identifies and manages privacy risk across its products and platforms. This team partners with Legal, Product, and Engineering to perform privacy assessments, manage privacy issues through the product lifecycle, and continuously improve the frameworks and tooling that keep customer data safe. You'll own the execution of complex privacy assessments for new products and features, drive issue remediation, and build scalable processes that embed privacy by design into how Coinbase ships.

What you'll do:

  • Own end-to-end privacy assessments for new products and features, synthesizing findings and driving remediation with cross-functional partners across Legal, Product, and Engineering.
  • Perform regulatory requirement mapping against the privacy common controls framework and identify where control updates are needed to address evolving obligations.
  • Track privacy requirements and issues throughout the product lifecycle, managing escalations and driving timely resolution with business owners.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams by embedding into roadmap planning processes and advising on privacy-by-design principles for onchain and web3 products.
  • Identify and implement automation and AI-driven process improvements to streamline privacy assessments and issue management workflows.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 3+ years in technology risk management with a focus on privacy or security, including hands-on experience conducting privacy assessments (DPIAs/PIAs, data flow reviews, or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated ability to map regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, ePrivacy) to operational controls and validate remediation efforts.
  • Proven ability to translate privacy legal guidance and product specs into functional requirements and actionable remediation plans.
  • Experience managing a high volume of concurrent assessments while balancing strategic priorities and stakeholder escalations across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with applying privacy principles to blockchain, onchain, and web3 products or willingness to develop this expertise rapidly.

jobs.description:
Pricing Strategy Director

The Monetization Strategy team drives Asana’s pricing/packaging strategy and execution, helping our customers get more value out of our offerings and capturing a fair share of that value.  We work cross functionally to deliver impactful offerings for team productivity and collaboration.  We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work.  Our team works directly with Product/Engineering, Sales/Support, Customer Research, Marketing, Data Science, Finance and Operations to deliver valuable offerings to our customers.  You’ll take part in every type of product work here – from strategy to product to process improvements – conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

As the Pricing Strategy Director, you’ll play an instrumental role in building and executing Asana’s product monetization strategy. Reporting to the Head of Pricing and Packaging, you will partner closely with Product, Sales/GTM, Marketing, Finance and operational leaders to launch and optimize our monetization strategy to drive sustainable revenue growth and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

This role can be based in our San Francisco or Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. jobs.title: Senior Customer Education Manager, Live Programs
jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

Fin's Customer Education team drives customer onboarding, adoption, and transformation at scale through on-demand and live educational experiences. Live programming has the opportunity to genuinely connect with customers in unique ways that cut through the noise to build relationships that drive adoption. As a result, we’re looking for someone who can make this program exceptional.

As our Senior Customer Education Manager, Live Programs, you'll own the live training program end-to-end: designing the curriculum, building and delivering the content, running our flagship Fin Academy Live event, and supporting strategic customers alongside our Deployment Services team. This is a high-visibility role where you'll regularly present to users, admins and C-suite audiences, and shape how Fin shows up in the room.

This role requires travel to support live events and customer engagements throughout the year.

What will I be doing? 

  • Own the live education program end-to-end by setting the vision, roadmap, and success metrics for what we run, for whom, and to what outcome.
  • Design and deliver engaging, live experiences including webinars, cohorts, in-person workshops, and our annual Fin Academy Live event in order to drive customer outcomes and retention. 
  • Partner with the Deployment Services team to define, create, and deliver tailored training to Enterprise customers, ensuring their teams are able to manage and scale Fin past the initial deployment.
  • Partner with the Customer Education team to plan and maintain a holistic training curriculum that supports our customers’ and company’s objectives to provide a cohesive, end-to-end learning experience across all of Fin Academy’s offerings. 
  • Continually iterate on offerings to increase their impact on onboarding, feature adoption, and automation rate and to incorporate feedback from customers, partners, and cross-functional teams. 

What skills do I need? 

  • 8+ years of training experience with 3–5 years in a SaaS or tech environment; professional services and/or customer success experience required. 
  • Strong grasp of adult learning principles and best practices that underpin effective and supportive live training experiences.
  • Proven content design skills with a track record of producing presentations and training that have clear information hierarchy, a relentless focus on driving customer action, and uses grounded examples to ensure concepts land.
  • Able to understand and clearly communicate complex, technical concepts and the nuances of AI products.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to deliver compellingly to both large audiences and small groups. This includes an ability to present in high stakes situations with our largest customers and their senior management. 
  • Skilled at maintaining engagement with all audiences and adapting in the moment whether that's managing a derailed discussion, a difficult question, or an unengaged group.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Sales Operations Manager to play a critical role in scaling systems, and processes for the organization. This role will partner with senior leaders across Samsara’s go-to-market teams to support our Enterprise Account Executives. This leader will have an outsized impact on the future of our sales organization by helping us Build for The Long Term as we grow past $1BN in revenue. The ideal candidate has exceptional customer service skills, proficient in maintaining customer records and compiling and analyzing performance reports which will drive efficiency for the Enterprise team.  

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to implement strategies that enable the Enterprise Sales team to spend more time in the field.
  • Assist in refining the process for intaking and prioritizing requests to minimize friction points in the sales pipeline.
  • Identify pain points for sales representatives and develop solutions that improve their day-to-day effectiveness.
  • Work across internal departments to drive the execution of improvements that increase revenue and profitability for Enterprise customers.
  • Work on complex initiatives relating to corporate strategy and long-term goals.

  • Proficiency in Salesforce.com and the overall sales technology ecosystem

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Bill Pay
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It's an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you'll do

The Bill Pay team is a high-functioning, product led team supported by product and design, building and leading the next generation of Accounts Payable (AP) software.  We’re looking for an engineering leader to have strong opinions on technical design and the willingness and eagerness to jump on customer calls.  This is one of the most important roles in Brex engineering as it perfectly sits between our Expense Management and Banking products.  

This is a founder-shaped problem: the domain is established, but the roadmap and how we get there is unwritten. If you're an ex-founder, this is your kind of opportunity.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a full-stack team (7-10 engineers) owning a defined part of Brex's next-generation Accounts Payable software, growing it through hiring and onboarding new engineers.
  • Help define and continually sharpen the team's mandate within the broader Payments group — what it owns, where to invest and how to continuously win customers.
  • Set the team's technical and product direction, making thoughtful tradeoffs about what to build, in what order, and why.
  • Ship a high-quality, reliable, competitive Accounts Payable product, balancing customer-facing feature velocity with a durable technical foundation.
  • Foster a people-centered culture, one built on enablement, trust, and context-sharing.
  • Partner cross-functionally across Design and Product to align on scope and delivery.
  • Provide strong coaching, mentorship, and career development for engineers at all levels.
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to how the team builds and operates. We expect you to be a continuous bar-raiser on AI for the team.
  • Translate customer feedback into engineering priorities. Drive product discovery and champion the user’s voice in technical trade-off discussions to ensure the team is building the right features for the right reasons.

Requirements

  • Track record of engineering leadership building and scaling customer-facing products, including hiring and growing teams.  
  • Strong product sense the ability to make and defend product and UX tradeoffs, not just technical ones.
  • A staff-engineer-level technical bar; able to operate at all levels and earn the technical respect of a strong engineering team.
  • Strong customer empathy and advocacy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Demonstrated coaching and mentorship of engineers across levels.
  • Minimum 2+ years in an engineering management role

Bonus points

  • Accounts Payable / Bill Pay domain experience 
  • Experience in a Payments domain (accounting, bill pay, credit card processing, banking integrations, ERPs, etc).

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $285,0

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. What you’ll do

This role is responsible for partnering with hiring managers and technical leaders to define team needs and role requirements, ensuring alignment on hiring goals. It involves sourcing, engaging, and assessing candidates through diverse channels, while managing the full recruitment cycle from outreach to onboarding. The position also focuses on creating strategies to attract and retain diverse technical talent, proactively building pipelines for present and future needs. Additionally, the recruiter will track and analyze key hiring metrics to improve processes, collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain fairness and efficiency, and champion Brex’s employer brand by representing the company at events and on social platforms.

Where you’ll work

  • ​​Lead sourcing and outreach efforts for technical roles, leveraging various tools and social platforms.

  • Coordinate and facilitate interview processes, ensuring a positive and efficient experience for both candidates and interviewers.
  • Provide regular updates and insights to hiring managers and stakeholders on pipeline health and recruiting progress.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate data in recruiting systems and dashboards.

  • Focus on attracting and evaluating top engineering talent with meaningful AI experience with strong core technical skills.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret recruiting metrics and make process improvements.
  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of recruiting.
  • Ability to manage multiple searches and priorities simultaneously.

Bonus points

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. Our job across comms, brand, creative, and social is to make Affirm a brand people trust and are proud to choose.

About the Role

Affirm's model only works when consumers succeed. No late fees. The full cost, known before you commit. A balance that ends.

Many people don't know that. Pay-over-time products are treated as interchangeable, and the revolving credit card is treated as the responsible default. We want to change this dynamic and evolve thinking and beliefs around what consumer-friendly credit can and should be as it modernizes.

The timing is the opportunity. Credit is being rewritten right now, in regulation, in coverage, and in how people talk about debt. The beliefs that settle over the next few years will shape the decades that follow.

This role focuses on the people who shape what the public understands about credit, the ones creating the coverage and content that drives the conversation.

You know who covers what, who matters beyond their outlet’s size, which newsletter a Hill staffer reads before the front page. And you know how to proactively build an argument that travels. The policymakers, regulators, and advocates who set the terms will use it, and the most skeptical reporter will want to write it.

You won’t be doing it alone. You’ll collaborate with colleagues who own the narrative you’re carrying, the research behind it, and the versions of this story told to consumers, merchants, and investors. You’ll also partner closely with a policy team that owns our government relationships and the positions we take. And because this story has to build across audiences and surfaces, you’ll help shape the broader brand and comms strategy rather than only drawing from it.

This story lives at the nexus of New York City and Washington, DC, so you can be based in either with regular time in the other.

What You'll Do

  • Develop the strategy and run the campaign. Decide what we’re trying to change, with whom, and in what order. Set the sequence, pick the moments, and know what each one is supposed to do. Shift the dynamic from an idea we’re explaining to language other people naturally use.

  • Shape what becomes news. Be in the conversations where people are deciding what to cover and what counts as news, weaving Affirm into them rather than reacting to them.

  • Build the proof. Help shape original consumer research and third-party data into evidence that lets people outside Affirm make the argument correctly and persuasively without us in the room.

  • Build the media bench. Earn the trust of a focused group of reporters, columnists, editors, producers, podcasters, and independent writers who shape consumer finance and policy conversations, and become the source they come back to, including on stories that aren’t about us.

  • Partner on outside voices. Work with our public affairs and government relations team to build lasting relationships with consumer advocates, academics, and credit experts, starting with listening rather than endorsement requests. Design the dinners, briefings, and roundtables where the right people meet each other and the argument gets pressure-tested in person.

  • Put our perspective where decisions get made. Prepare executives and credible outside spokespeople for the moments that matter, from op-eds to panels and interviews, and work with public affairs so the arguments and themes we care about reach policymakers, regulators, and the people who advise them.

  • Know whether it is working. Track whether the argument is actually showing up: in how reporters frame the category, in the language advocates and policymakers use, in earned sentiment. Bring the honest read, including when a tactic is visible but not moving anything.

What We Look For

  • Campaign mindset: You think in arcs rather than announcements, built around the forces that actually shape the public conversation, and you know it’s landing when others start making the argument without you.

jobs.title: Atlassian Administrator II
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

We’re looking for an Atlassian Administrator who is organized, customer-focused, and excited to build deeper expertise across Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and the broader Atlassian Cloud ecosystem.

In this role, you will support the day-to-day administration and operation of Braze’s Atlassian platforms, helping teams work more effectively through reliable configuration, responsive support, clear documentation, and thoughtful automation.

You will serve as a key point of contact for Atlassian requests across the business, supporting everything from access and permissions to workflows, project configuration, JSM queues, dashboards, reporting, and troubleshooting. You will work closely with our Lead Atlassian Solutions Engineer to ensure changes are implemented consistently and in accordance with Braze’s platform governance and change management standards.

You will also contribute to larger initiatives including platform cleanup, workflow consolidation, service management improvements, automation, ScriptRunner development, and Braze’s growing use of Atlassian Rovo and AI agents.

If you enjoy solving problems, helping users, improving systems, and continuing to develop your technical skills in a large Atlassian Cloud environment, we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Work On

You’ll support the operation and continued improvement of Braze’s Atlassian ecosystem, including:

  • Platform Administration and User Support:
    • Manage the day-to-day request queue for Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, resolving configuration, access, reporting, and usability issues while keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Jira and JSM Configuration:
    • Configure and maintain projects, workflows, screens, custom fields, issue types, request types, queues, SLAs, forms, permission schemes, notification schemes, and customer portals.
  • Automation and Operational Efficiency:
    • Build and maintain Jira Automation rules that reduce manual work, improve consistency, and support repeatable business processes.
  • Rovo and AI Enablement:
    • Support and improve Rovo agents by maintaining instructions and knowledge sources, troubleshooting unexpected behavior, testing new use cases, and gathering feedback from users.
  • Reporting and Visibility:
    • Create and troubleshoot JQL queries, filters, dashboards, and reports that provide teams with visibility into workload, service performance, and operational trends.
  • Governance and Access Management:
    • Manage users, groups, roles, and permissions while supporting license reviews, access reviews, change management, and documentation requirements.
  • Documentation and Enablement:
    • Maintain platform documentation, knowledge articles, and training materials, including async walkthroughs that help teams self-service common Atlassian tasks.
  • Platform Improvement Initiatives:
    • Partner with the Lead Atlassian Solutions Engineer on project rollouts, workflow consolidation, JSM improvements, platform cleanup, application integrations, and other initiatives that improve the scalability and usability of the Atlassian environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and manage incoming Atlassian administration requests, prioritizing work based on business impact and urgency.
  • Configure and maintain Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence configurations across projects, workflows, fields, permissions, queues, forms, SLAs, portals, spaces, and templates.

As a Lead Services Consultant, you'll be the expert voice on services during the pre-sales process and a trusted commercial partner to our Sales, Solutions Consulting and Partnerships teams across EMEA. You'll own a high-volume pipeline of concurrent ServCon requests, including the region's largest and most complex deals, working independently to scope, position, price and present the right services for a range of prospective customers.

About the team

Braze's Services Consultants (ServCon) are the services experts on our pre-sales deals. We partner with Account Executives, Solutions Consultants and deal teams to understand what each prospect needs to succeed with Braze. Then we scope, position and price the right mix of services, including onboarding and implementation, Technical Account Management (TAM) and professional services.

A growing share of Braze implementation projects involve system integrators, technology partners and channel partners who are co-selling alongside Braze. You'll need to be comfortable navigating these structures and know how to position both Braze and partner services, depending on what each prospect could benefit from.

You'll also play a meaningful internal role by enabling the sales organisation, contributing to go-to-market materials and building thought leadership that raises the bar for how Braze Services is perceived and sold across the region.

Responsibilities

Pre-sales ownership

  • Own EMEA ServCon request intake and manage a concurrent pipeline of active deal requests, with appropriate prioritisation and deal selectivity. Deliver high quality responses from first discovery to the final services proposal.
  • Partner with Sales during live deal cycles including RFPs, discovery sessions, pitches, executive meetings and on site customer visits, including deals where a system integrator or channel partner is co-delivering.
  • Lead services discovery with prospects' senior stakeholders to understand their team maturity, technical resources, timelines and goals, and turn that into clear services recommendations.
  • Scope and price services: build SOWs, develop project plans, resourcing models and pricing justifications for onboarding, TAM and professional services engagements. Partner with Deal Desk and Services leadership on non-standard terms.
  • Provide clear, commercially grounded recommendations on which Braze service package best fits the customer's needs and defend that recommendation confidently when challenged.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work closely with Solutions Consulting on complex, multi-workstream enterprise deals where ServCon and SolCon scopes overlap.
  • Build and maintain active relationships with the Braze Partner team to stay ahead of partner involved opportunities: understand which SIs and channel partners are active in your accounts and how to structure services scope alongside their delivery.
